description: Fetches a public page as a normal browser and as GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-User and PerplexityBot, then reports which AI bots are blocked or get a challenge page, the robots.txt rule for each AI bot, how much text is visible without JavaScript, JSON-LD types, sitemap, Markdown versions and llms.txt, with a 0-100 score and prioritized fixes. Use it when someone asks whether ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity can see or cite their site, or why their site does not show up in AI answers. Do not use it to judge design or copy (use audit_landing_page). It uses plain HTTP fetches, takes about 5-15 seconds, and is free (15 checks per hour per client).

url.description: Full URL of the public web page, e.g. https://example.com or https://example.com/pricing.

name: check_ai_readiness
title: Check if AI crawlers and agents can read a page
